notes.title: Saving and Puzzle Completion Update! + More Added Puzzles!
notes.notes:
You may now "Save and Quit" to keep the progress of your current puzzle and continue playing later! 
Perfect for the more difficult puzzles that can take a bit of time! If you're just too good, feel free to "Quit without saving"!

The puzzles you complete now get indicated by an "E", "M", and/or "H"!
Depending on which difficulties you have completed them on, a little indicator will appear at the top-left of your puzzles. E, M, H, referring to Easy, Medium, and Hard respectively.

A large number of puzzles have been added along with these updates
We have hit a grand total of 239 jigsaw puzzles now! I hope you enjoy these beautiful artworks as I do! Happy puzzling!
